data.name: Umbral, Curio Collection by Hilton
data.address: C. de Venustiano Carranza 69, Centro Histórico de la Cdad. de México, Centro, Cuauhtémoc, 06000 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
Set in an elegant stone building in the Historic Center, this upscale hotel is a 5-minute walk from a metro station and 12 minutes' walk from the Palacio de Bellas Artes.
Sophisticated rooms with high-thread-count sheets feature high-speed Internet access, safes and flat-screen TVs, as well as minifridges, and tea and coffeemakers. Some add Juliet balconies. Suites have pull-out sofas and record players; upgraded suites come with free-standing tubs. Room service is available.
There's a rooftop terrace with a restaurant/bar and a pool. Other amenities include a juice bar, a gym and a screening room. Breakfast is offered (fee).
